title: Fixed income securities
audience: a college student in a finance, accounting or business degree program, or a career changer studying the same material on their own
purpose: Price bonds and compute yields, spot and forward rates, measure interest-rate risk with duration and convexity, analyze credit risk and spreads, value bonds with embedded options, and understand mortgage-backed and other securitized products.

weeks.3: Spot rates, forward rates and bootstrapping

blocks.deliverable: Price ten bonds and compute their yields.
Bootstrap a spot curve from par yields.
Estimate price changes with duration and convexity.
Week 7 midterm; compute expected loss for a bond.
Value a callable bond on a binomial tree.
Compute prepayments on a mortgage pool.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Bond portfolio project: build a portfolio of five to eight bonds to match a liability, compute its duration and convexity, immunize it against a parallel rate shift, test it under three rate scenarios in Python, and write a two-page report.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
